title: The wrong cost changes the result before the strategy does.
paragraph1: Many traders optimize their setup but ignore real spreads, slippage, holding costs, and differences between instruments on the same underlying.
paragraph2: TradeScope starts from the operational combination and measures where cost becomes decisive. Not from the product, but from the real cost of the combination you are using.
quote: There is no universally best instrument. There is the most efficient combination for the operational context.
card_note: TradeScope shifts the analysis from the product to the real cost of the combination used.
row_1_pattern: Asset, strategy, and horizon must be compatible with each other.
row_2_pattern: Real spreads and execution quality impact results before the setup.
row_3_pattern: Funding, rollover, and structural costs weigh on net results.
